json.notes: The de Young is a long, low copper-clad box with a perforated metal skin, sitting in a flat plan with a cantilevered front. Behind it, toward the east and the back, a tall observation tower stacks up in sheared, offset storeys, with each higher block leaning out over the one below. I model the low main volume and the three stepped and offset tower blocks in dark copper-brown, with no window grid because the skin reads as solid metal.

final.notes: The de Young is a long, low copper-clad box with a perforated metal skin, sitting in a flat plan with a cantilevered front. Behind it, toward the east and the back, a tall observation tower stacks up in sheared, offset storeys, with each higher block leaning out over the one below. I model the low main volume and the three stepped and offset tower blocks in dark copper-brown, with no window grid because the skin reads as solid metal.
